claimed_scope: Deterministic workpackage-generation/claim -> causal parent -> invocation/tool-use/delegation -> causal child -> optional observed result identity binding. Identity/provenance only; no child spawn, provider/model call, UnifiedDB mutation, delivery lifecycle, completion decision, effect authority, VPS or whole-system runtime credit.
fused_invariants: workpackage_generation and claim_id are explicit and distinct from causal generation
parent and child use canonical F2-WP-101 CausalIdentity
child must name parent.causal_id and strictly advance causal generation
child remains in the same session at this binding layer
invocation_id, tool_use_id and delegation_id are explicit replay/cross-talk discriminators
result identity is absent or fully bound as result_id plus lowercase SHA-256
result attachment repeats invocation/delegation/child causal identity and exact replay is idempotent
binding_id is stable across later result attachment while full binding digest changes
completion, effect and result-outcome authority are deliberately absent from F2-WP-102
